text:
[Council File 26-1394]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF POLICE COMMISSIONERS relative to a Memorandum of Understanding Between the City Of Los Angeles and Axon Enterprise, Inc. for the Lightpost Test Pilot Program.
(Public Safety Committee report to be submitted in Council. If a public hearing is not held in Committee, an opportunity for public comment will be provided.)
(Please visit www.lacouncilfile.com for background documents.)
TIME LIMIT FILE - 10/27/2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - 10/27/2026)
[On October 6, 2026, the City Council adopted Motion (Soto-Martinez - Harris-Dawson), pursuant to Charter Section 245, asserting jurisdiction over the September 22, 2026 action of the Board of Police Commissioners.]
